scope: Continue R07 cost lineage on a diverged phase branch without rewriting or upgrading historical v2/v2.1 results.

lineage.cross_branch_inheritance: Count only identities and amounts supported by byte-bound ledgers. Missing historical tokens, time, fees, or inherited cost remain null with a field-specific reason and keep cumulative cost incomplete.

preservation.prior_result_policy: Retain prior v2/v2.1 inputs, tools, readers, results and issues byte-for-byte; a new reader may classify their original status but cannot upgrade it.
preservation.invalid_policy: A historical INVALID remains INVALID with its original issue codes and reasons.
preservation.no_estimation: Never infer tokens or fees from logs, elapsed time, model names, or usage-limit displays.

time_usage_money.unknown: Every missing field is null with a specific reason; null is not zero.
time_usage_money.intervals: Record only directly instrumented monotonic intervals; do not infer active time from gaps.

code_delta.baseline: The exact current session start commit, not the diverged historical measurement reference.
path_class_order: asset/benchmarks/**/*.py as benchmark code before the broad asset/data rule
remaining model, manifest and asset data as data
code_delta.effective_loc: Reuse the prior v2 token/AST fingerprint implementation on exact source snapshots and correct only its path-classification ordering in the v2.2 adapter. Preserve literal token spelling; count ambiguous reuse conservatively.

gates.structural_pass: Confirms commit ancestry, byte identities, schemas, explicit unknowns, prior-result preservation, and LOC source snapshots only.
gates.measured_complete: Requires all required time, token, billing, inherited-cost and source evidence fields to be present and independently verified.
gates.sol_review: Required before this continuation protocol is used to make a cumulative R07 cost claim.
